Container.Name: LanGuard-Scanner
Container.Overview:
LanGuard Scanner (Scheduler) is the network discovery engine for LanGuard. It performs automated Layer 2 ARP sweeps, service scans, port monitoring, Wake-on-LAN actions, and local Docker container inventorying.
[b]NOTE:[/b] This is the scanner/scheduler component of the LanGuard stack. It requires host networking and privileged mode to execute raw socket ARP scans. Must share the same [inline]/data[/inline] directory and [inline]SECRET_KEY[/inline] with [b]LanGuard-Backend[/b].
[b]Credits & Support:[/b] - Created by [b]Yossi Hillali[/b] ([url=https://github.com/hillaliy/LanGuard]GitHub[/url]). Support the developer on [url=https://www.paypal.me/hillaliy]PayPal[/url]. - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.
